description: $0.02 USDC on Solana per verdict - Your payment includes one demand verdict for the tool or service description you submit: one labelled demand claim per requested H1 leg (provider, class H1, licence, attribution, that leg's data-date, and its grade — ASKED-FOR, NOT-ASKED-FOR stated as absence in that leg only, or NOT-ASSESSABLE when the leg is not loaded), the served-leg grade against the stated supply (ALREADY-SERVED with each matching supply record labelled, NOT-SERVED against the stated supply only, or NOT-ASSESSABLE), the printed claim ceiling (H1 only; at A1 this verdict can claim nothing), the A1 absence statement, and the per-leg factors. No composite score is included. It does not include any agent-issued search-query data (class A1 — none is published by anyone), any claim sourced from ShareChat or Radar API data (barred, CC BY-NC), any MCP Registry compilation data (terms unclear — excluded), or retention of your submitted description (it is discarded; only its hash is kept).

description.description: The tool or service description to assess demand for.

legs.description: H1 leg ids to include; defaults to all cleared legs.

question_class.description: Optional question class for the verdict.
